name: Cre8 Enterprise Limited Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Operating through its various divisions, Cre8 Enterprise Limited offers a comprehensive suite of financial communication and document production services. The firm caters to publicly listed entities, prospective initial public offering (IPO) companies, and private enterprises within the financial and capital markets of Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China, primarily recognized under its "Cre8" brand. Its extensive service portfolio covers the entire lifecycle of financial reports and regulatory compliance documents, starting from initial concept development, graphic design, and typesetting, through expert proofreading, multilingual translation, physical printing, binding, and seamless logistics coordination. Cre8 also manages the electronic submission and uploading of these vital documents to stock exchange platforms and for broader media dissemination. Beyond its core printing operations, the company provides digital marketing expertise, including website creation, brand identity development, content generation, and technical support for various promotional assets. Furthermore, via its "Cre8IR" online platform, Cre8 facilitates the widespread distribution and publication of corporate announcements, circulars, financial results, and pertinent industry news feeds. Established in 2006, Cre8 Enterprise Limited is based in Central, Hong Kong, functioning as a subsidiary of Cre8 Investments Limited.
